approval.approval_reference: ChatGPT Architecture Review approval: end-of-body synthesis required and reflected by P08 before References (2026-08-19 JST)

editorial_thesis: 2023–2026年の車載E&Eアーキテクチャは、ECUを単純に『中央へ集める』変化ではない。物理I/O、計算資源、通信、サービス/データ契約、開発・検証、そして安全・セキュリティの責務境界を再配置する変化として捉えると、zonalとcentral/HPC、EthernetとCAN XL、標準仕様とOSS platformが一つの連続した設計問題として見えてくる。
architecture_goals: 物理的zonal化と計算のcentral/HPC化を対立概念ではなく相補的な責務分割として説明する。
centralizationの利点だけでなくmixed-criticality・ASIL・isolationが作る集約限界を一次資料と研究Evidenceで示す。
Automotive Ethernet/TSNを主軸にしつつCAN XLと10BASE-T1Sを含め、用途別のnetwork fabricとして整理する。
VSS、SOME/IP/vSomeIP、AUTOSAR Adaptive/ROS 2、S-CORE等をECU製品名ではなくservice/data/software responsibility boundaryとして比較する。
CI/CD、software integration、diagnostics、digital twin/VILをArchitectureの外付け工程ではなくSDV E/E設計の一部として扱う。
functional safetyとcybersecurityを独立した付録ではなく全層を制約するcross-cutting concernとして統合する。
本文の最後に独立した総括を置き、各章で示した責務境界の再配置を一つの設計像として再統合する。

packages.title: Front Matter / 読み方とEvidence境界
packages.editorial_angle: 調査期間、Evidence class、標準・論文・OSSの読み分け、AUTOSAR/ISO取得gapを先に明示する。
must_cover: 一次資料優先と未解決事項の保持
arXivだけでは標準化・実装動向を取りこぼす理由

packages.title: Lead — 『中央集約』ではなく責務境界の再設計
packages.editorial_angle: zonal、central/HPC、determinism、service orientationを別々の流行語として並べず、物理I/O・compute・network・software contractの責務再配置という一つの設計問題に統合する。
must_cover: determinism/reliabilityを後段各章への接続点にする
boundaries: The authors frame the interview analysis as qualitative rather than statistically significant; findings therefore should not be treated as population-level quantitative validation.
The practitioner interview study is tied to Daimler Truck AG and the paper discusses external-generalizability limits; architecture conclusions should be treated as contextual rather than universal.

The five-component architecture is a survey-derived vision; the paper discusses validation paths rather than establishing production deployment or end-to-end certification of the complete architecture.
Many architecture-transition statements synthesize cited literature and industry material and should not be treated as independently measured facts from this paper.

packages.title: Compute — HPC統合とmixed-criticalityの現実
packages.editorial_angle: ECU削減という物量の話から離れ、mixed criticality、ASIL decomposition、virtualization、resource governance、hardware isolationがHPC統合の上限を決めることを示す。
boundaries: The review does not apply snowballing and excludes some inaccessible/non-English material, including Chinese-language papers and SAE reports; the authors acknowledge publication-bias risk.

The authors note that limited public industry data hinders validation of recent automotive software-architecture advances and that gray literature/expert interviews could improve current-practice coverage.
Best practices transferred from avionics/cloud and the review's applicability outside automotive require further investigation.
The paper shows different start-up behavior on AMD64 and ARM64, so the percentages are not portable across hardware/runtime configurations without retesting.
The authors explicitly find that the best microservice/container count is neither necessarily the maximum nor minimum and must be determined experimentally.
The study is a performance evaluation, not evidence that virtualization/containerization automatically satisfies automotive safety isolation, certification, or deterministic timing requirements.

For simplicity, the model assumes coexistence/freedom-from-interference criteria are satisfied when mixed-criticality tasks share hardware; the optimization does not itself establish the complete safety argument for that coexistence.
Scalability experiments use a fixed four-ECU architecture with randomly generated task graphs and randomized WCET/WCRT/cost values, limiting direct transfer to a production E/E program.
Reported objective values and solver timings are case-study/problem-instance results rather than universal design-space optimization performance.
The paper explicitly focuses on initiator-side mechanisms and defers resource-side developments.
The open-source QEMU/CPU/Bao proof-of-concept is presented as a roadmap rather than completed validation in this paper.
The demonstration is a simulated SDV environment; the authors explicitly identify a more comprehensive demonstration with realistic automotive hardware and software as future work.

The authors note that online integration on the vehicle may be restricted to relatively small problems because vehicle compute resources are limited; larger-scale analysis is better suited to design time.
The PoC predefines VMs because the selected ACRN setup has limited runtime configuration flexibility.

packages.title: Network Fabric — TSN EthernetとCAN XLの役割分担
packages.editorial_angle: Ethernet一本化ではなく、TSNによるdeterministic backbone、10BASE-T1S等のedge接続、CAN XLのbackbone/sub-backbone可能性を物理・論理両面から比較する。
must_cover: CAN XL / ISO 11898-1:2024 public status boundary
boundaries: Which detailed mandatory/optional TSN feature selections and configuration parameters are normative in the full IEEE Std 802.1DG-2025 text?
This verification used public IEEE project/publication pages; detailed normative requirements and parameter values in the full standard were not independently inspected.
The ISO 11898-1:2024 normative text was not available through the pinned Source Intake; this card verifies only the public CiA description and standardization status.
The committee page establishes document scope/version status but does not by itself prove that a specific PHY/ECU product passes the conformance or interoperability suites.
This page verifies channel/component specification activity and versions, not electrical performance of any particular production harness or connector implementation.
The central controller is a potential single point of failure during reservation/setup, although established real-time data paths do not continuously depend on it.
Hard deadline guarantees can require substantial bandwidth overprovisioning relative to less conservative schemes.
Reliable delivery/retransmission is treated as orthogonal to the strict real-time reservation problem, and redundancy mechanisms such as FRER are left for extensions.

packages.title: Service & Data — ECU境界から契約境界へ
packages.editorial_angle: サービス指向をAPIという語だけで扱わず、vehicle signal semantics、service discovery、middleware/runtime、ROS 2との境界まで含む『ソフトウェア契約の独立化』として整理する。
boundaries: VSS specifies a vehicle-data taxonomy/model and associated tooling; these releases do not by themselves establish a transport protocol, service runtime, or OEM-wide adoption.
Release notes establish project changes, not independent SOME/IP conformance, production deployment scale, safety qualification or comparative performance.
The same page makes broad adoption/deployment statements; this card does not treat those as independently verified production-deployment evidence.
Results are configuration- and Linux-testbed-specific; the authors identify embedded-platform evaluation as future work.

Two configurations were omitted as not meaningful: vSomeIP best-effort above the small-message case because SOME/IP-TP was not implemented, and Zenoh reliable because the selected reliable configuration did not affect transmission.
The paper itself shows topology/data-rate dependent reversals, so its measurements should not be generalized into a single universal middleware ranking.
What latency, jitter, CPU/memory overhead and failure-mode behavior would CARISMA exhibit on automotive HPC hardware and deterministic in-vehicle networks?
Validation is a two-VM proof of concept rather than embedded automotive HPC hardware or an in-vehicle network.
The authors explicitly defer a sound evaluation of CARISMA overhead versus direct inter-service communication to future work.
The prototype intentionally uses exactly one proxy per HPC and does not claim redundant proxy behavior.
AUTOSAR Adaptive/QNX is evaluated in QEMU rather than on an automotive target ECU/HPC.
The implementation/evaluation is tied to ROS 2 Humble, Fast DDS, vsomeip 3.4.9.1 and AUTOSAR Adaptive R20-11; interoperability across other implementations/releases requires separate evidence.

packages.title: Open Platform — S-COREが示す共通実装への移行
packages.editorial_angle: 仕様策定だけでなく共有core stack/reference implementationへ進む動きを、S-COREのlaunch→release maturityとSOAFEE系実装の両面から追う。
must_cover: AUTOSAR Adaptive industry frictionはpartial evidenceとして限定
boundaries: Statements such as 'production-ready' or predictable/safe behavior are project claims unless backed by separate certification, conformance or deployment evidence.
The announcement included forward-looking release targets and safety-process goals; those targets are not treated here as proof of later delivery or certification.
What exact runtime/platform component baseline was delivered in v0.1.0 beyond the existence of the tag/release?
Which S-CORE components had production-grade or safety-qualified status at each release, as distinct from documentation/process maturity?

Release notes are project-authored evidence of repository changes; they do not by themselves establish production deployment, interoperability, functional-safety certification or automotive-grade maturity.
The v0.1.0 release page provides a release and full-changelog link but no detailed release-note body, so its exact technical baseline is unresolved from this source alone.
The page is authored by DENSO and hosted by SOAFEE; deterministic guarantees and portability/safety benefits are vendor/project claims rather than independent certification evidence.
The pinned article does not provide a sufficiently detailed independent latency/jitter or safety-certification evaluation for quantitative comparison.
Inspect the full paper for minimal-AP components, industry context, detailed pain-point taxonomy, attribution evidence and threats to validity.

The accessible primary abstract does not expose the minimal-AP implementation scope, participant/industry context, concrete pain-point inventory, trace from each pain point to specification/vendor/local causes, or study validity discussion.
Findings explicitly mix specification, vendor implementation and local practice; they should not be generalized as intrinsic AUTOSAR Adaptive defects without item-level attribution.

packages.title: Lifecycle — SDVではintegration/diagnostics/validationもArchitectureになる
packages.editorial_angle: 中央計算機とサービス分離が進むほど、variant management、CI/CD、自動integration、diagnostics、digital twin/VILがE&E architectureの成立条件になることを示す。
boundaries: The evaluation is a laboratory setup using TurtleBots, ESP32-based ECU emulation and a central backend, not a production vehicle/fleet validation.
The authors explicitly identify deployment to a larger connected-vehicle testbed and deeper feature-model/variant-management integration as future work.
The evaluation uses CARLA and workstation-class hardware to emulate the vehicle/sensor-actuator environment; it does not establish behavior on production automotive compute or physical vehicle buses.

The authors list stronger cybersecurity measures, throughput/processing optimization and reliable real-time operation as future work, so those properties are not fully established by the current evaluation.
The demonstration is a simulated SDV environment; the authors explicitly identify a more comprehensive demonstration with realistic automotive hardware and software as future work.

The authors note that online integration on the vehicle may be restricted to relatively small problems because vehicle compute resources are limited; larger-scale analysis is better suited to design time.
The PoC predefines VMs because the selected ACRN setup has limited runtime configuration flexibility.
Inspect the full paper for dynamometer/vehicle/server setup, synchronization architecture, case-study metrics, and comparison with conventional ViL/HIL.

The accessible primary text does not expose case-study scenario definitions, central-server hardware, timing/accuracy metrics, synchronization error, comparison baseline, or quantitative development-effort reduction.
The evaluation is centered on autonomous-driving software; conclusions about other centralized vehicle domains require separate evidence.
The evaluation is a controlled 5G test-fleet/smart-charging scenario with injected faults rather than broad production-fleet fault distributions.
Graph-based rankings identify likely root causes; their correctness depends on dependency/causal graph quality, anomaly detection, and the selected analysis module.

packages.title: Cross-cutting Deep Dive — Safety / Security / Trust Boundary
packages.editorial_angle: Safety/Securityを独立ECUへ逃がす前提が崩れると、isolation、resource partitioning、service authentication、deterministic runtimeが各層横断のarchitecture contractになる。
boundaries: The evaluation shows high performance jitter, attributed partly to parallel execution on a single system; Open vSwitch/Mininet emulation also omits physical network transmission times.
Supply-chain attacks, secure builds, OTA distribution and some mixed-security downgrade cases are outside the detailed security analysis.
The main automotive evaluation does not include remote DNSSEC resolution in the service-setup path; the authors expect such resolution to occur during update procedures.
The paper explicitly focuses on initiator-side mechanisms and defers resource-side developments.
The open-source QEMU/CPU/Bao proof-of-concept is presented as a roadmap rather than completed validation in this paper.

For simplicity, the model assumes coexistence/freedom-from-interference criteria are satisfied when mixed-criticality tasks share hardware; the optimization does not itself establish the complete safety argument for that coexistence.
Scalability experiments use a fixed four-ECU architecture with randomly generated task graphs and randomized WCET/WCRT/cost values, limiting direct transfer to a production E/E program.
Reported objective values and solver timings are case-study/problem-instance results rather than universal design-space optimization performance.
The page is authored by DENSO and hosted by SOAFEE; deterministic guarantees and portability/safety benefits are vendor/project claims rather than independent certification evidence.
The pinned article does not provide a sufficiently detailed independent latency/jitter or safety-certification evaluation for quantitative comparison.

packages.title: 総括 — 2026年夏の到達点と残る設計課題
packages.editorial_angle: 本文各章で分解した物理配置、計算資源、network fabric、service/data contract、open platform、development lifecycle、安全・セキュリティを再び一枚のE&E設計像へ統合する。『centralize everything』ではなく、責務をどこに置き、何を契約として固定するかが2026年時点の本質的な設計課題であると結論づける。
must_cover: physically zonal / computationally centralized の再確認
Ethernet中心だが単一busではない
ECU境界からservice/data/resource contractへの移行
software development/validation infrastructureもE&E architectureの一部
安全・セキュリティ・determinismが中央集約の実効上限を決める
標準仕様・OSS実装・OEM/Tier1実装の間に残る検証gap
